notes.title: Notice: Fixed Bugs Related to The Celestial Weapons etc.
notes.content:
[h2]We are pleased to announce that we have updated the application today,  fixing the following bugs.[/h2]

[list]
[*] Update date: February 6, 2023
[*] Version: 1.1.0217
[*] How to update: Please follow the instructions on the app's dashboard.
[/list]
[h3][Main updates/fixes][/h3]
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Celestial Weapons disappeared after holding hands with Haru under certain conditions.
[*] Other minor adjustments.
[/olist]

We hope you find [i]The Tale of Onogoro[/i] even easier to play with this update and bug fixes.
We would appreciate your continued feedback and requests.

tags.bug: [*] Fixed an issue where the Celestial Weapons disappeared after holding hands with Haru under certain conditions.

notes.title: Notice: Addition of Comfort Vignette adjustment function etc.
notes.content:
[h2]We are pleased to announce that we have updated the application today,  adding the following features and fixing the following bugs.[/h2]

[list]
[*] Update date: December 5, 2022
[*] Version: 1.1.0171
[*] How to update: Please follow the instructions on the app's dashboard.
[/list]
[h3][Main updates/fixes][/h3]
[olist]
[*] Compatibility support for Meta Quest Pro.
[*] Allowed to adjust the Comfort Vignette in 4 strength levels (Inactive, Small, Medium, Large).
   *Please try this setting if you are prone to VR sickness.
[*] Modified to increase the amount of healing by joining hands/time passing when Shield Mode (easy difficulty) is selected.
[*] Added Simplified Chinese UI interface and subtitles.
[*] Other minor adjustments.
[/olist]

We hope you find [i]The Tale of Onogoro[/i] even easier to play with this update and bug fixes.
We would appreciate your continued feedback and requests.

Allowed to adjust the Comfort Vignette in 4 strength levels (Inactive, Small, Medium, Large).

notes.title: Notice: Change in Method of Model Recognition for VR Devices
notes.content:
[h2]We are pleased to announce that we have updated the application on Steam Store today, adding the following functions and fixing the following bugs.[/h2]

[list]
[*] Target distribution store: Steam
[*] Update date: October 26, 2022
[*] Version:  1.1.0152
[*] How to update: Please follow the instructions on the app's dashboard.
[/list]
[h3][Main updates/fixes][/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]We have changed how we recognize VR devices to improve compatibility between various HMDs and controllers.[/b]
This allows you to play with HMD and controller combinations from different manufacturers that are compatible with SteamVR.
When an unsupported controller is used in the "The Tale of Onogoro" application, a dialog box will be displayed with setting instructions so it can be manually adapted.
[*][b] Other minor adjustments.[/b]
[/olist]

We apologize for any inconvenience that these bugs may have caused you.
We hope you continue to enjoy The Tale of Onogoro.

tags.feature: [b]We have changed how we recognize VR devices to improve compatibility between various HMDs and controllers.[/b]

notes.title: The Tale of Onogoro is available today! & Launch Sale!
notes.content:
[h2]The SteamVR version of The Tale of Onogoro has finally been released today.[/h2]

To celebrate the launch of the SteamVR version, a 20% off sale will be held starting today.
In conjunction with this release, The Tale of Onogoro Original Soundtrack is now also available for purchase on the Steam Store.

The SteamVR version of the game features graphic options such as high-resolution rendering, soft-shadow effect enhancements, as well as extra post-processing effects, all of which are aimed at providing gamers with higher-quality experiences according to their PC specifications. 

*Please refer to the Official website "[url=https://onogoro.info/en/howtoplay/]How to Play[/url]" page for more details, along with instructions on how to operate the game with a SteamVR-compatible VR headset.

[h3]◆Overview of the Launch Sale[/h3]
[list]
[*] Period: September 28, 2022 - October 5, 2022, 10.00 AM PDT
[*] Eligible for: SteamVR version of The Tale of Onogoro
[*] Price: 34.99 USD → 27.99USD (20% off/ Prices may differ across regions)
[/list]

[h3]◆Overview of the SteamVR version[/h3]
[list]
[*] Title: The Tale of Onogoro 
[*] Genre: VR Action-Adventure Game
[*] Supported HMD: Valve Index, HTC VIVE, HTC VIVE Pro/ Pro2, HTC VIVE Cosmos/ Cosmos Elite, Oculus Rift/ Rift S, Meta Quest/ Quest 2, Windows Mixed Reality Immersive Headset
[*] Supported Hardware: PC fitting the requirements of the above HMDs (Intel® Core i5 7500/ NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or above/ OS: Windows 10 (64bit) / Memory: 8GB or more)
[*] *The information has been changed from that published on August 10, 2022. Please be advised.
[*] Number of Players: 1
[*] Online Play: No online play available
[*] Rating: IARC 12+
[*] Price: 34.99 USD (excluding tax, Prices may differ across regions)
[*] Release Date: September 28th, 2022
[/list]

[h3]◆Overview of Soundtrack on Steam[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780998/2969c0d8100c1f0fb10a26daebbe4f9fab7ccdad.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Album Title: The Tale of Onogoro Original Soundtrack
[*] 22 songs including “The Tale of Onogoro” feat. Yumiko Takahashi, “Gondola no Uta” feat. Rekka Katakiri
[*] The content is the same as the original soundtrack already distributed.
[*] Price: 9.99 USD (excluding tax, Prices may differ across regions)
[*] Release date: September 28th, 2022
[*] Steam store page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2110660/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2110660/[/url]
[/list]

[h2]Bundle editions with The Tale of Onogoro soundtrack and Last Labyrinth are also available.[/h2]

In conjunction with the release of the SteamVR version of The Tale of Onogoro, a bundle edition with both The Tale of Onogoro and its soundtrack is now available for purchase. At the same time, a different bundle edition that includes the SteamVR version of the VR Escape-the-Room Game, Last Labyrinth, Amata’s first-ever VR game and the companion title of The Tale of Onogoro, has also been released. Bundle editions are available at cheaper prices than if you buy the individual products separately.
 
[h3]◆Overview of The Tale of Onogoro Soundtrack Edition[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780998/34a31a500ad06697c1b35be4e15041c1ad671db0.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Bundle contents: The Tale of Onogoro game software, The Tale of Onogoro original soundtrack
[*] Price: 44.98 USD→40.48 USD (10％OFF/ excluding tax)
[*] Steam store page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/27394/The_Tale_of_Onogoro_Soundtrack_Edition/]https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/27394/The_Tale_of_Onogoro_Soundtrack_Edition/[/url]
[/list]


[h3]◆Overview of The Tale of Onogoro + Last Labyrinth VR Adventure Pack[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780998/eba236a4702473c785dcfcae436b1b0cdddde393.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Bundle contents: The Tale of Onogoro game software, Last Labyrinth game software
[*] Price: 64.98 USD→51.98 USD (20％OFF/ excluding tax)
